WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-85.189732 42.420649, -85.279669 42.419969, -85.279916 42.419967, -85.29958 42.419801, -85.307808 42.419733, -85.308012 42.463589, -85.30791 42.50005, -85.30798 42.50005, -85.308104 42.507867, -85.190633 42.508339, -85.189732 42.420649))', 4326) AS g
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g)
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast))).max AS elevation
FROM clipped;
